label: B25-LOGIC-IMM-QUARTUS-REGRESSION
title: Build a synthesis-visible regression for the two failing uart_getc logical immediates
scope: Create a hermetic directed decoder/ALU regression and minimal Quartus 21.4 synthesis/post-map probe for the exact uart_getc opcodes. The old base must be retained as the negative control; do not edit RTL or expected architectural values.
directed_cases: representative valid 32/64-bit masks compared against an independent reference decoder
acceptance: Behavioral oracle passes; a fresh old-SHA Quartus run deterministically records warning 16788 and/or wrong produced logic as a negative result; the runner is reusable on the merged fixed SHA and fails closed on warning, semantic mismatch, missing report or stale output.
resource: All GamePC/Quartus activity must hold gamepc and use only the task remote root; local compile/simulation that is heavy must hold local. No concurrent writer may share its output path.
forbidden_regions: tracked RTL, firmware, existing test expected results or common test registry
full physical fitter/STA/assembler unless mechanically required for a proven post-map semantic check and explicitly recorded
JTAG, board, FPGA configuration, Flash/JIC/EPCQ, reset or power

dispatch.monitoring: event-driven, up to one-hour waits, no frequent polling

result.old_negative: PASS; fresh old synthesis reproduced warning 16788
result.fixed: PASS; fresh candidate synthesis warning 16788 count 0
